summary: The Olshin book on the Rossi "Marco Polo" maps was published in 2014, not 2019, and it leaves the question of authenticity open rather than calling the sheets copies or fabrications.
find: The Rossi collection sheets have been examined (2019 monograph by Benjamin B. Olshin) with the conclusion that they are post-medieval copies or fabrications; this inventory records the catalogue status only.
replace: The Rossi collection sheets are examined in Benjamin B. Olshin, The Mysteries of the Marco Polo Maps (University of Chicago Press, 2014), which sets out arguments for and against their authenticity and reaches no firm conclusion; this inventory records the catalogue status only.
